capabilities: Start timed sessions that render as a live session bar in the note
Finish sessions to write end time and duration into the block
Run pomodoro cycles with focus and break phases and alerts on phase change
Hand-edit session blocks in several time formats
Show the active session in the status bar
disambiguation: Not a time-blocking planner; it times sessions while you work and writes the results into the note.
extras: The README notes that alerts only work while Obsidian is open, and that mobile lacks the status bar and system notifications.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to time study or work sessions and keep the record inside the note itself.
summary: Session tracker that inserts timebox code blocks into notes recording start and end times, duration, and an optional pomodoro cycle.
